reasoning_content: Interesting — `ls /app/dist/bin/` returned nothing, and `ls /app` also returned nothing. But the process is running `node dist/bin/maildev.js` — so the working directory must be somewhere else. Let's check the process's cwd.

action.command: docker exec startuphafen-devcontainer-maildev-1 sh -c 'readlink /proc/1/cwd; ls -la /proc/1/cwd/ | head -12' 2>&1
